vocabularyDefinition.nl: Record is a indexed set of objects. It can be associated to a RecordType in such a manner that the class of an indexed value object is of the class specified by the RecordType's correspondingly indexed TypeName. A Record  is a NameSpace for its included attributes.

applicationProfileDefinition.nl: Basis datastructuur bestaande uit een collectie van velden van mogelijk verschillende datatypes, typisch een vast aantal in een bepaalde volgorde.

vocabularyDefinition.nl: A RecordType is a look up mechanism that associates AttributeNames to TypeNames. AttributeNames are locally mapped. TypeNames are most often either primitives, or other types in the same schema as this record. Because the RecordType can control the structure of a set of Records, it is essentially a metaclass for that set of records view as a class. A RecordType is a NameSpace for its included attributeTypes.
